intentAndPurpose.intent: Ordered hierarchy navigation with semantic links, plain-text current page, optional home icon, count-based overflow menu, and measurement-gated truncation tooltips.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Total visible positions, including the overflow trigger. Minimum 3.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Optional validated maximum width for the whole trail.

props.name: maxWidthItem
props.description: Validated CSS length; defaults to the existing 320px tooltip-width token.

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: Localized accessible name for the overflow trigger.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a Tooltip only after a rendered label is measured as clipped.

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage

interactionBehavior.summary: Breadcrumb is a `<nav>` / `<ol>` trail of sequential Tab stops, not an arrow-key composite. The current crumb (default: the last item, or `currentId`) is a plain `<span aria-current="page">` — never a link, even if that item also has `href`. Parent crumbs are OneUI Links at `--{Role}-Low`; hover does not recolour or underline them. Overflow is count-based and SSR-stable: with `overflow` and more items than `maxItems` (minimum 3, including the trigger), middle ancestors collapse into a Menu behind an IconButton, while the first and current crumbs always stay visible.
hover: Parent Links keep `--{Role}-Low` and `text-decoration: none` on hover — colour does not step up and no underline appears, matching Figma's low-attention text button. Wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)`.

A truncated label (`truncate` + measured `scrollWidth > clientWidth`) mounts a Tooltip with `trigger="hover"` (Base UI also shows it on keyboard focus). The tooltip is the disclosure; the string itself never expands.
The current crumb has `cursor: default` and no hover rule. The home-as-icon control has no hover fill of its own (press is opacity-only).
press: A parent Link that is not `aria-disabled` drops to `--Pressed-Opacity` while held. The current span does not.
The home-as-icon `<a>` uses the same pressed opacity. Click never toggles an expanded-label state — tests confirm `data-expanded` is not introduced and `onPress` still fires.
Overflow hidden items are Menu.Items (links when they have `href`); choosing one fires that item's `onPress` and follows the href.
focus: Parent Links and the home-as-icon control draw the two-layer halo: `--Stroke-XL` gap in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer `--Focus-Outline` ring (spread `calc(var(--Stroke-XL) + var(--Focus-Outline-Width))`).
`:focus` only clears the native outline; the ring is `:focus-visible`.
The current crumb is a non-focusable span. Separators are `aria-hidden` presentation chevrons and are not in the tab order. Overflow is an IconButton, so it uses IconButton's own halo.
keyboard: Sequential Tab through each parent Link (and the home-as-icon `<a>` when `homeAsIcon`), then the overflow IconButton when collapsed. There is no arrow-key roving along the trail.
`Enter` / `Space` on the overflow trigger open the Menu of hidden ancestors (IconButton + Menu). Menu keyboard behaviour is Menu's once open.
Home-as-icon never nests an IconButton inside the link — a single focusable `<a>` (or a `role="img"` span when that crumb is current) holds the glyph, so Tab does not land twice.
selected: The current crumb is `aria-current="page"` on a `<span class="current">` in `--{Role}-High`, `cursor: default`. `currentId` defaults to the last item. An item with `href` that is current still renders as this non-link span.
Parent crumbs stay `--{Role}-Low` Links. Hierarchy is colour, not weight — both ends use `--Label-FontWeight-High`.

With `overflow`, collapse is count-only: `maxItems` includes the `moreHorizontal` trigger, the first and current indices are invariant, and remaining visible slots favour the deepest ancestors. Hidden items keep source order inside the Menu.
disabled: An item's `disabled` is forwarded to the parent `Link` and to overflow `Menu.Item`. The pressed-opacity rule excludes `[aria-disabled="true"]`.
Disabled does not turn a current crumb into a link or skip it — current is still the non-interactive span. Breadcrumb CSS has no additional disabled dimming of its own.
touch: Parent-link hover colour never applies on touch-only devices (there is no colour change anyway); the tap response is the pressed opacity plus navigation.
Clicking a truncated label navigates — it does not expand the ellipsis. Use the overflow IconButton to reach collapsed ancestors.
